content: {"question":"If an employee moves from GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand to GitLab LTD in the UK, how do the employer contributions to their retirement plans differ in terms of rate and tax treatment?","answer":"In New Zealand GitLab contributes 3 % of the employee’s base salary to KiwiSaver, subject to Employer Superannuation Contribution Tax, whereas in the UK GitLab does not make employer contributions to bonus or commission earnings under the pension scheme.","evidence_a":"**Rate:** 3% of your base salary (paid on top of your salary)","evidence_b":"Employer contributions are not applied to Bonus or Commission earnings."}
